subject: Solution fit summary & next steps — demo scheduling + eval kickoff
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Dawson <claire@healthsync.io>, Tom Nguyen <tom@healthsync.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap & next steps — scheduling demo + eval kickoff

Hi Claire / Tom —

Thanks again for the time today — really helpful to understand HealthSync's ingestion cadence and the user flows you want to accelerate with embeddings (search + rerank for clinician notes, and a triage-assistant for inbound patient messages). Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Key constraints we noted: PHI-in-transit restrictions, night-batch ETL for older archives, 1s median latency target for the triage flow.
- Success criteria you mentioned: 90% precision on rerank top-3 for a 500-query prompt set, end-to-end latency < 1s p50 on a 128-token response for the triage assistant.

Next steps I propose:
1) Schedule a technical demo / deep-dive (60m) — we’ll show model options, quantization/cost tradeoffs, and outline the trial topology.
2) Schedule an evaluation kickoff (30–45m) to lock down trial plan, success criteria, and the initial prompt set we’ll test.

I attached a short "Redwood Eval Playbook" with a sample trial plan and a proposed prompt pack — please take a look and tell us which parts you want to change.

Can you share your availability for the demo (60m) in the next two weeks? To make scheduling easier, proposed windows (PT):
- Tue May 18, 10:00–11:00 or 14:00–15:00
- Wed May 19, 13:00–14:00
- Thu May 20, 09:00–10:00

If those don't work, suggest two windows that do. For the evaluation kickoff I expect a shorter meeting and can offer blocks right after the demo on the same week.

Also, for the eval we'll need a technical contact who can approve a short connectivity test (S3 access or a sample export) and someone from security for the questionnaire. If Tom could be the infra contact, that would be perfect.

Attachments: Redwood_Eval_Playbook_v1.pdf (summary + sample trial plan), HealthSync_Proposed_TrialPlan.xlsx (editable).

Regards,
Mateo Alvarez
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

From: Claire Dawson <claire@healthsync.io>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Nguyen <tom@healthsync.io>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 16:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery recap & next steps — scheduling demo + eval kickoff

Thanks, Mateo — great notes and the playbook looks sensible at a glance. Tom and I talked briefly after the call; we're aligned on the three target use cases. A few quick items before we lock dates: 

- Security: we need SOC 2 Type II evidence and an architecture diagram showing how keys and logs are handled during evaluation. Can you share those?
- Data access: For the trial, we prefer delivering a sanitized export to an S3 bucket you specify; is that supported?
- Attendees: I’ll join for product/clinical, Tom will cover infra (S3 + VPC questions). Our procurement person (Lina) may join the kickoff depending on timing.

For the demo windows, Tue May 18 14:00–15:00 PT works best for both of us. If you can hold that, we can tentatively schedule the demo then and do the evaluation kickoff the following week (we're available Wed May 26 morning PT or Thu May 27 mid-day PT).

On SOC2 and architecture: can you drop the SOC2 brief and a short infra diagram? If you already have a shared Drive folder, I can add Lina and our security reviewer.

Claire
Head of Product | HealthSync
claire@healthsync.io | +1 (415) 555-4321

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Dawson <claire@healthsync.io>, Tom Nguyen <tom@healthsync.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 08:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery recap & next steps — scheduling demo + eval kickoff

Claire — thanks, confirmed for Tue May 18 14:00–15:00 PT for the demo. I booked the slot on the calendar and attached a draft agenda to the event.

We can deliver SOC 2 Type II summary + architecture diagram. I uploaded a short package to the Drive link below and added a README for what we'll hand to your security reviewer. I'll also add the sample connectivity checklist so Tom can scan it ahead of the demo.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cEvalPack (sharing set to view for anyone with link; I can add Lina explicitly if needed).

For the evaluation kickoff, Wed May 26 09:00–09:45 PT is open on our side — if that works for your team, we can reserve it now. During the kickoff we'll: 
- Finalize trial topology (S3 export vs direct connector), data retention and redaction rules.
- Agree on prompt set (I propose we start with 200 queries: 100 search/rerank, 100 triage-style prompts).
- Confirm measurement plan (what you log, thresholds, and alerting cadence).

To make the kickoff efficient, can you (or Lina) confirm the top-3 success metrics and whether the sanitized S3 export will include sample patient notes (PHI redacted)? If PHI removal will be handled by you, we'll sign an NDA addendum to cover the transfer.

Attachments uploaded to Drive:
- Redwood_Eval_Playbook_v1.pdf
- HealthSync_Proposed_TrialPlan.xlsx
- Redwood_SOC2_Summary.pdf
- Redwood_Architecture_Diagram.png

Looking forward to the demo — I'll include a brief model-comparison handout and a cost/latency projection for the trial topology.

Best,
Mateo
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
